context: A police officer briefs on financial-crime risks
purpose: Teach: 出費/税関/駆けつけ/散々/利息/定時/月間/多忙

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 御社の海外出費、税関連動の異常、警察で監視中です。
lines.en: We've flagged some irregularities in your company's overseas transactions — customs-related patterns we're currently monitoring.
lines.style: Measured official tone. Even pacing, no hurry. Professional distance maintained. Direct eye contact, no accusation in the voice — just fact-stating.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。先月、警察が駆けつけた事案、ありました。
lines.en: Yes. There was an incident last month that required a police dispatch.
lines.style: Careful, measured response. Slight hesitation before answering — not evasive, just choosing words precisely. Cooperative but guarded.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 散々な広報対応、改善できますか。
lines.en: The public relations response to that was rough. Can that be improved?
lines.style: Not unkind, but direct question. Slight lean forward. Practical tone — not interrogating, genuinely asking if they have a plan.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 利息の流れ、月間で集計しています。
lines.en: We're tracking the interest transfers on a monthly basis. All consolidated.
lines.style: Steady, informational delivery. Professional but slightly tense — defensive without being defensive. Showing compliance, not volunteering extra.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 担当者、多忙な中、定時で済ませる体制を。
lines.en: Your team — I'd like to see a structure that lets them finish on time, even with this workload.
lines.style: Shift to something almost paternal. Slower pace. Not a demand, but a suggestion that carries weight. Closing with care.
